mapper.select: SELECT id, scene, name, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_library_label l WHERE l.set_id = s.id AND l.deleted = 0) AS labelCount FROM label_library_set s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_library_set (scene, name, description, sort_order, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{scene}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_library_set SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE label_library_set SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: SELECT l.id, l.set_id AS setId, s.name AS setName, s.scene, l.parent_id AS parentId, l.label_name AS labelName, l.color, l.tool_type AS toolType, l.node_type AS nodeType, l.default_size_l AS defaultSizeL, l.default_size_w AS defaultSizeW, l.default_size_h AS defaultSizeH, l.is_rigid AS isRigid, l.min_inside_points AS minInsidePoints, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.keypoint_template_json, '$')) AS keypointTemplate, l.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM label_library_label l JOIN label_library_set s ON s.id = l.set_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0
mapper.select: AND l.set_id = #{setId} ORDER BY l.sort_order, l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE label_library_label SET label_name = #{labelName}, color = #{color}, tool_type = #{toolType}, node_type = #{nodeType}, default_size_l = #{defaultSizeL}, default_size_w = #{defaultSizeW}, default_size_h = #{defaultSizeH}, is_rigid = COALESCE(#{isRigid}, is_rigid), min_inside_points = #{minInsidePoints}, keypoint_template_json = COALESCE(#{keypointTemplateJson}, keypoint_template_json), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE label_library_label SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_class ( class_set_id, label_name, color, tool_type, default_size_l, default_size_w, default_size_h, is_rigid, min_inside_points, keypoint_template_json, sort_order, status, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT #{classSetId}, l.label_name, l.color, l.tool_type, l.default_size_l, l.default_size_w, l.default_size_h, COALESCE(l.is_rigid, 0), l.min_inside_points, l.keypoint_template_json, l.sort_order, 'active', #{userId}, #{userId} FROM label_library_label l JOIN label_library_set s ON s.id = l.set_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.set_id = #{setId} ORDER BY l.sort_order, l.id

INSERT INTO label_class ( class_set_id, label_name, color, tool_type, default_size_l, default_size_w, default_size_h, is_rigid, min_inside_points, keypoint_template_json, sort_order, status, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT #{classSetId}, l.label_name, l.color, l.tool_type, l.default_size_l, l.default_size_w, l.default_size_h, COALESCE(l.is_rigid, 0), l.min_inside_points, l.keypoint_template_json, l.sort_order, 'active', #{userId}, #{userId} FROM label_library_label l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.sort_order, l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE label_text_class SET parent_id = #{parentId}, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
